scope: Original output initializer and its original configuration/submission callees execute end-to-end for both channels; fixture supplies bound DMA resources and two buffers. Only first-buffer submission and drain are verified, not task dispatch or automatic refill.
assumptions: Descriptors, buffer state, already-bound resource flag and DMA object pointers supplied in RAM.
DMA global enable and nominal audio clock enabled by harness.
CPU IRQs masked; project-authored polling waits for real DMA completion and FIFO drain.
Opaque data words; no physical PCM interpretation or host sound.
